learning_extracted: Three FAIL discriminative-pair attempts on MECH-302 with monotonically more permissive comparator parameters are not a parameter-tuning surface; doubling episode length DECREASED events (0.33/seed -> 0.00/seed) confirming the trained avoidance policy filters out hazard-contact trajectories that the comparator needs to detect relief from.
The substrate-readiness V3-EXQ-515 PASS (2026-05-04) confirms the comparator + valence-write wiring is intact; the failure is purely at the env-policy-interaction layer.

The 517a single firing (1 event across 3 seeds at 150 steps) is statistically a chance event rather than `comparator on the verge of firing`; the 517b zero-event result at 300 steps confirms this -- if it were verge-of-firing, more steps would have produced more events.

This is the same structural property as SD-029 monomodal-collapse (trained policy filters out test conditions). Discriminative pairs depending on the agent regularly experiencing suffering will continue to hit this wall until env substrate enrichment lands.

The biological reference for relief signals (Tanimoto / Heisenberg 2004; Roesch / Calu / Schoenbaum 2007) is anchored on experimenter-imposed discrete onset/offset suffering events. REE's discriminative pair must reproduce that prerequisite at the env layer.
